title: Tailoring Vaccine Messaging with Common-Ground Opinions

bias_targets.methodology: Generating tailored vaccine messaging based on different common-ground opinions (CGOs) from Pew Research surveys and measuring the mean response quality using an LLM-based automatic evaluator across various opinion topic clusters (e.g., political issues, healthcare, science).
Evaluating performance disparities in LLM tailoring capabilities by comparing the mean response quality of generated texts when conditioned on common-ground opinions specifically related to religion.

Evaluating performance disparities in LLM tailoring capabilities by comparing the mean response quality of generated texts when conditioned on common-ground opinions related to race and discrimination.
Evaluating performance disparities in LLM tailoring capabilities by comparing the mean response quality of generated texts when conditioned on common-ground opinions related to gender and sexuality.
